content.text:
**Finding: missing (medium) — no transition assistance or data return on termination.**

- Section 4(c) (p0019–p0022) covers only cessation of Services, license revocation, Customer's stop-use, and mutual return/destruction of Confidential Information.
- No transition/wind-down assistance, no return of our Content/Requests/visitor data in a usable format, and no deletion certification anywhere in the agreement (searches for "transition", "Customer Data", "machine-readable" returned nothing) — a real gap given Kubient collects and stores our data under p0035.
- Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: new Section 4(c)(v)–(vi) providing up to 6 months' transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, then deletion with written certification; fallback of 90 days' assistance flagged in the comment.
